title: phlomoides glanduligera
intro: Phlomoides glanduligera, commonly known as the glandular phlomoides, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Phlomoides glanduligera include its use in traditional medicine to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Phlomoides glanduligera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
